# health-chat

Private local lab-results chat — Qwen3.8-27B via llama.cpp/MLX, fully local, no cloud. Labs only.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agent quick start: clone, install, fetch, model download, llama-server, run, API endpoints
- [README.md](README.md) — overview, minimum specs (32GB RAM / 16GB VRAM for 27B Q4_K_M), quick start
- [docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md) — install and troubleshooting
- [docs/HARDWARE.md](docs/HARDWARE.md) — minimum specs
- [docs/MODELS.md](docs/MODELS.md) — model download and verification
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — privacy model (127.0.0.1 loopback, no cloud, Bearer passcode)
- [DISCLAIMER.md](DISCLAIMER.md) — not medical advice
- [resources/manifest.json](resources/manifest.json) — guideline manifest (fetcher, not redistributed)
- [scripts/install.sh](scripts/install.sh) — installer
- [scripts/fetch_guidelines.py](scripts/fetch_guidelines.py) — guideline fetcher

## Constraints

- Qwen3.8-27B only (Q4_K_M ~16.5 GB, needs 32GB RAM or 16GB VRAM); do not claim smaller hardware
- Local only: binds 127.0.0.1:8787, LLM at 127.0.0.1:8080
